purpose: Post-migration state modelling: observed outcome of one switch-ownership migration (or of no action) on a 2-controller SDN. Re-collection of the v1 matrix with capacity-v4 (c_safe 933 pps on the current VM), because v1 was collected with capacity-v3 (1433 pps, measured on an older VM) and most v1 attempts ran with a saturated controller.
topology: 2C20S v1 (2 Ryu controllers x 20 OVS switches, Mininet, GCP e2-standard-8)
action: switch ownership migration (OpenFlow role change + barrier + verification), one per attempt
quality_gate: required: every window snapshot passes the Hard Gate (valid = fresh and complete and consistent)
failed_transactions: retained (RESTORED / FAILED / SKIPPED are kept, training_eligible = false)

split.rule: split by repeat (scenario + repeat), never by row: every pre/post sample of an attempt stays in that attempt's split; NO_OP controls follow their repeat

collection.mode: one attempt per run: orchestrator restart, fresh workload, controllers reset to the default ownership before every attempt
collection.dirty_tree_check: git status --short empty and HEAD equal to the tag commit (b47a2d9) when the collection finished; the runner on the tag only warns on a dirty tree

switch_selection.seeded_random: uniform among the switches owned by the source, seeded by (seed, attempt_id)
switch_selection.hot_switch_alternating: hot_switch workload only; in each matrix cell about half of the repeats move the hot switch, the others a seeded random switch

analytic_check.definition: x = control-load share of the moved switch (pre window), y = -Delta U_src (after_mean - before_mean); expected = switch rate / C_safe of the source

backup.verified: SHA256 computed before upload; per-attempt SHA256SUMS OK for 340/340 (Vy, 2026-10-29)

known_limitations: capacity-v4 (c_safe 933 pps, controller_capacity.json sha256:952c64644b99) was measured on the current VM; U values are comparable with v1 only after rescaling by 1433/933, and v1 U is censored where its controller was saturated

20 of 340 attempts (14 MIGRATE, 6 NO_OP) have a saturated controller (CPU p95 >= 95%) in at least one phase, concentrated in burst_1 and hot_switch peak with destination 0.75; see evidence/week12/attempt_saturation.csv
measured loads can differ from the planned levels (hot-switch share and the destination levels); use the measured values, never the plan
official collection has no failure injection; every migration committed
notes: destination overload after migration: 10 of 300 COMMITTED attempts have dst_u_after_mean >= 1.0 (about 1.04), all in hot_switch high/peak with destination 0.75, two directions; v1 had none
saturation check: CPU p95 stays below 95% for U < 1.0 and reaches 97.9% for U >= 1.0 (evidence/week12/cpu_vs_u_v2.txt); v1 reached 98.7% already at U 0.70-0.72
phase early includes the workload warm-up: delta_*_mean and delta_*_last can differ (keep both, later weeks choose)
every attempt is kept, none imputed or dropped; saturated attempts are flagged in attempt_saturation.csv, not removed
open_decisions: cause of the capacity difference between the old and the current VM is not identified; capacity-v4 adoption and the setup/throughput knees (140 / 160 flows/s) need My and the advisor
